integrity: The finite-chain covariance and propagator are prior literature. The claimed addition is an N-dependent near-critical Gaussian field limit and its calibrated covariance. Independent scientific and priority audits have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional mesoscopic spatial distribution convergence for a homogeneous open linear Gaussian directed OU chain only; does not establish full continuous-path tightness, nonlinear robustness, correlated bath noise, spatial-boundary scaling, or entropy production.
title: Stochastic-heat spatial scaling at a nonreciprocal Langevin exceptional point
